title: Upgrade to v1.35.0 (GetProfile answers NOT_FOUND for absent profiles)
summary: Availability fix from the 2026-08-13 security review. The GetProfile query returned an unclassified error when an address had no profile, which is a normal post-consensus state: an account can be deleted while blocks that reference it are still being projected. Callers could not tell 'this account is gone' from 'this node is broken', so the indexer aborted the block, retried it forever, and stopped advancing for every reader on that host. GetProfile now returns the gRPC NOT_FOUND status for an absent profile and the indexer skips the refresh instead of failing the block; every other status still aborts, so a real node or transport fault is not silently recorded as 'this user has nothing'. This is a query-path change only. Transaction handling, state writes and the app hash are untouched, so this upgrade is not consensus-breaking and mixed binaries do not diverge. The plan exists to move the fleet across one coordinated height and keep every validator on the same binary, since a node left behind keeps wedging its own indexer.
